post.label: Lamp post
post.line: A clay lamp post pulled out of the street

girder.label: Girder
girder.line: A steel beam out of a broken building

chunk.label: Chunk
chunk.line: A piece broken off a building

limb.label: Limb
limb.line: An arm or a leg torn off a frame

tower.label: Water tower
tower.line: A full water tank on legs

grab.label: Grab
grab.line: Pick up a loose thing (a post, a girder, a piece of building, a limb)

throw.label: Throw
throw.line: Throw the thing in your hands where you aim
throw.keys: RMB with a thing in hand

thunderclap.label: Thunderclap
thunderclap.line: Clap both hands. The shock in front staggers and breaks glass

groundPound.label: Ground Pound
groundPound.line: Punch both fists into the ground. Everything near is knocked off its feet

elbowDrop.label: Elbow Drop
elbowDrop.line: Drop elbow first from the air. The higher the drop, the harder the blow

superJump.label: Super Jump
superJump.line: Hold Space, then release. Jumps two and a half times as high

battering.label: Battering Ram
battering.line: Boost into a building and straight through its walls

uppercut.label: Uppercut
uppercut.line: A blow up through the chin. Knocks a giant's head back, or a roof off

spin.label: Wrecking Spin
spin.line: With a club in hand, hold LMB. A full turn that strikes all round
spin.keys: LMB held with a club in hand

javelin.label: Javelin
javelin.line: Throw a post or girder point first. It goes through what it meets
javelin.keys: RMB held, let go, with a post or girder

shieldUp.label: Slab Shield
shieldUp.line: With a slab of building in hand, press V. It blocks blows from the front until it breaks

giantThrow.label: Giant Throw
giantThrow.line: F on a staggered giant: lift it, then RMB throws it where you aim, LMB slams it down
giantThrow.keys: F on a staggered giant, then RMB or LMB
